implementation: Reuse observed_admission_completion.Owner unchanged as the sole account owner. A subclass tracks only a per-symbol consecutive health counter. Reset it on observed actual full liquidation; requested, blocked and partial exits do not start a new flat campaign. Health is the parent's fresh readiness AND no existing price exit AND close above the same Config.fast simple moving average. Only after Config.recovery healthy closes may the subclass clear a flat symbol's readmission veto before the unchanged parent decision. No early release on the actual-liquidation close, while inventory remains, or while a protective obligation remains unresolved. The parent's existing full-entry confirmation can also release readmission as before. All current full entry, positive score, support, capacity, cash, stop-risk, concentration and execution tests still apply. The rule adds no numerical parameters and does not reset stops, ceilings, account NAV history, risk state or protective exits. Reject duplicate/out-of-order observations before mutating the new counter.

These are decisions, not manufactured fills. Retain original parent archives and the raw attribution/witnesses with source, data, method and manifest identities. No counterfactual portfolio replay is needed to reconstruct original witnesses.
